report.summaryEn: You gave strong, specific answers about your background and strengths, but missed opportunities to show interest in the company during the motivation and final question.
report.strengthsEn: Excellent self-introduction and clear, concrete examples when describing your strengths.
report.improveEn: Practice connecting your motivation to the specific company's work and always prepare a question to ask at the end of the interview.
report.pronunciationEn: Clear pronunciation with a consistent pace, making the responses easy to understand.
report.verdictReasonEn: Strong technical background and good communication in the first half, but lack of company research and engagement in the second half.

criteria.commentEn: Used polite expressions and appropriate closings during the self-introduction.
Started with direct answers in the self-introduction and strengths questions.
Provided specific examples of project work and testing in Q1 and Q3.
Did not connect the motivation and final question to the specific company.
Maintained polite 'desu/masu' forms throughout the interview.
Responses varied; Q1 and Q3 were well-structured, but Q2 and Q4 were too brief.
Showed a positive attitude in Q1 and Q3, but lacked enthusiasm in Q2 and Q4.

improvements: Connect your reason for applying directly to the company's specific work and mission.
Always ask a thoughtful question at the end of an interview to show your enthusiasm.
